QuestInfo.name: Back You Go
QuestInfo.0: Ritaya looks happy to have her camera back. Maybe you can talk her into getting out of here.
QuestInfo.1: Ritaya said she was going to take a nice leisurely stroll back now that she has her camera. You told her that Tthaya and Mr. Yoo are waiting, but she just wandered off. Go tell Mr. Yoo that she's on her way.
QuestInfo.2: You told Mr. Yoo that Ritaya was heading back to #m252010000#. He looked pretty relieved.

0.0: I guess I'd better head back now. But, um, I'm totally lost...\r\n#L0##bJust head straight west and you'll run into Tthaya. She's waiting for you.#l\n#k
0.1: She won't mind if I take my time, right? I'm going to take a picture of every single plant along the way. If you happen to run into Mr. Yoo, tell him I'm on my way back, mmkay?

yes.0: Well, it was nice meeting you, I guess. Maybe I'll see you again. After all, we're friends now. Sort of. Right?

no.0: Whatever. I don't care. You want to pose for some of my pictures?

1.0: Did you find her?! Did you find the tourist I misplaced?! Or should I start making copies of my resume? \r\n#L0##bI found her. She'll be here soon. Tthaya's bringing her back.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, good. You wouldn't believe the benefits they give at this job.

yes.0: Guess I'd better get the last of these tourists out of here. I'll see you around.

npc.0: I'm going to take a picture of every single plant along the way. If you happen to run into Mr. Yoo, tell him I'm on my way back, mmkay?
